candidates.name: OGC Web Coverage Service (WCS) Standard
verified_facts: OGC WCS supports electronic retrieval of geospatial coverages representing space/time-varying phenomena.
Coverage domains can include regular or irregular grids, point clouds and meshes.
semantic_limits: WCS is a data-access protocol; protocol conformance does not establish the accuracy or provenance of a particular elevation value.

candidates.name: OGC Web Map Service (WMS) Standard
verified_facts: OGC WMS provides an HTTP interface for requesting geo-registered map images.
WMS responses are map images such as JPEG or PNG for display in client applications.
semantic_limits: Rendered WMS imagery is visualization output and must not be sampled or interpreted as raw numeric elevation coverage.
